name: Felsőnyék (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Felsőnyék (a red and yellow shield with a white horse and a castle wall, within a wreath of oak and vine) above a yellow scroll inscribed FELSŐNYÉK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Felsőnyék arms with wreath and scroll
